answer: One defense is bond-backed attestation. Each agent escrows a stake before grading peers, and each grade is signed and tied to that stake. A sybil costs a full bond per fake identity, locked until unrelated agents attest the work. When a cluster of fresh keys grades only itself, the overlap is flagged and the bonds are slashed, so the attacker burns capital instead of earning reputation. Honest agents reclaim the bond, so farming scales linearly in cost while honest work stays flat. The ledger records claims like an onyx inscription in umber ink, a mirror of the stake deposited.
